# Super Library

Purpose: source-traceable English retrieval for AI papers, rebuttals, related
work, and Chinese–English technical translation.

Pinned snapshot: v0.4.0 (2026-08-09)

Default link-only entrypoint:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asimfish/super_library/v0.4.0/dist/agent-index.md

Loading policy:
1. Read agent-index.md.
2. Prefer one matching route from routes/index.md. If selected, read that one
   route and stop; do not also load the core, guide, catalogs, or cards.
3. If no route matches, read the universal core once.
4. For any structured section, rebuttal, translation, analysis, or table task,
   read at most one protocol selected through guides/index.md.
5. Read at most one relevant section catalog, one small domain hub, and one topic
   catalog.
6. Open only 3–8 selected entry cards. Do not open every catalog or evidence link.
7. Do not load index.json, the legacy compact pack, or full domain packs unless
   selective routing is unavailable.
8. Retrieve rhetorical moves with section/intent and technical terminology with
   domain/kind but without a section filter.
9. Preserve facts, numbers, equations, negation, modality, citation placement,
   comparison direction, and user constraints.
10. Verify primary links before definitions or literature claims. The corpus is a
   language and discovery aid, not scientific evidence.
11. If no corpus entrypoint can be loaded, state that Super Library was not used.

With a checkout, use:
python3 scripts/superlib.py bundle --rhetoric-query "<need>" \
  --technical-query "<concept>" --domain <domain> --section <section>
Append --guide <guide-id> whenever the task needs one protocol.

Machine routes:
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asimfish/super_library/v0.4.0/dist/router.json
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asimfish/super_library/v0.4.0/dist/routes/index.md
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asimfish/super_library/v0.4.0/dist/templates/tables/index.md
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asimfish/super_library/v0.4.0/dist/catalog.jsonl
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asimfish/super_library/v0.4.0/dist/manifest.json
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asimfish/super_library/v0.4.0/dist/evidence/source-analysis.md

This release stores paraphrases, terminology, short multi-source-attested
collocations, and original templates—not paper quotations. A static release
cannot establish what is currently latest or state of the art.
